theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_mickle_rado_density_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ψ : OuterMeasure (Eucl (m + 1))) (K : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (r : ℝ), IsClosed K → ψ K = 0 → C ≠ ⊤ → 0 < r → (∀ z ∈ K, ∀ τ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) r, ψ (ball z τ) ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (τ ^ (m + 1))) → ∀ᵐ c ∂((volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))).restrict K), limsup (fun t : ℝ => ψ (ball c t) / ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) = 0
